counterfactual_missing_items: No clinical evidence of internal involvement was found on ultrasonography, computed tomography, or magnetic resonance imaging results.
decisive_items: Multiple yellow to reddish brown firm papules and nodules were present on the scalp, face, neck, trunk, and limbs, including the axillae and inguinal regions.
Dense diffuse cellular infiltrate composed mainly of foamy histiocytic cells and multinucleated Touton cells mixed with lymphocytes and eosinophils.
response.rationale: R1 is the champion because it has the most comprehensive support from both clinical presentation and histopathological findings, while R3 lacks clinical presentation support and R2 has contradicting evidence of no internal involvement.

rejected.why: Lack of internal involvement on imaging studies makes it less likely.
